name: glyph-compress
displayName: GlyphCompress — Cut Your LLM Token Bill
description: Cut the tokens your IDE-to-LLM coding session is billed for. Stops re-sending files the model already has, places provider cache breakpoints where they cover the request, and compresses what genuinely needs sending - measured against real tokenizers, not character counts.

glyphCompress.compressionLevel.description: Compression aggressiveness (light=prompts only, standard=+files, aggressive=+full code→semantic, ultra=semantic summaries)

glyphCompress.trustPolicy.description: Trust policy that controls which compression transformations are allowed

glyphCompress.showStatusBar.description: Show compression stats in status bar

glyphCompress.autoUpdateWorkspaceRules.description: Automatically write GlyphCompress instructions to .cursorrules and .github/copilot-instructions.md

glyphCompress.targetApiUrl.description: Base URL to forward proxy traffic to (e.g., https://api.openai.com or https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com)

glyphCompress.experimentalDecay.description: Experimental: Enable Attentional Decay Compaction to progressively compress older chat history

glyphCompress.holographicFolding.description: Enable Holographic Context Folding to group overlapping related files and import boilerplate into layered structure blocks

glyphCompress.intentDiffs.description: Enable Generative Intent Diffs to condense verbose unified git/IDE diffs into extremely short symbolic change action lines

scripts.prepublishOnly:
node -e "console.error(String.raw`
  This is the VS Code extension manifest, not the npm package.
  Publishing from here ships extension.js and every stale .vsix instead of the
  library - no bin/, no src/, so npx glyph-compress breaks on latest.
  Run npm publish from the repository ROOT. Use vsce publish for the Marketplace.
`); process.exit(1)"
